scores.notes: Both show a round, stone-walled pit open to a daylit sky, with a sandy floor, lions inside and Darius leaning over the rim. The masonry differs (large tan blocks on the left, smaller pale bricks with a wooden hatch on the right), but the views are compatible as the same den seen from inside and from above.
Daniel (rising from the pit on the left, standing before the throne on the right) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and a lined, older lean face in both.
In the banquet on the left, Daniel has short grey hair, a grey beard and tan skin. In the den on the right he has close-cropped black hair, a dark beard and clearly darker brown skin.
Daniel climbing out of the pit on the left has grey, receding hair, a grey beard and tan skin. The Daniel standing among the lions on the right has short black hair and noticeably darker brown skin.

Daniel in the den (left, centre) has dark brown skin and close-cropped black hair. In the vision on the right (profile) he has olive skin and fuller, wavy dark hair, so skin tone and hair style conflict.
Daniel in the den on the left has dark brown skin, black cropped hair and a dark beard. Daniel at the banquet on the right has lighter olive skin, salt-and-pepper grey hair and grey stubble.
Both Daniels (standing at the banquet on the left, being helped from the pit on the right) have short greying hair, a short grey beard, olive-tan skin and a lean, older face.

Daniel in the vision on the left (profile) has thick dark hair, a darker beard and a fuller, younger face. Daniel at the banquet on the right has close-cropped grey hair, grey stubble and a gaunt, older face.

Both are round pits lined with grey stone, with steps at the rim, palms beyond and daylight, Darius at the edge and lions on a sandy floor. The entrance differs (an iron grille on the left, a wooden arched door on the right), but the place is otherwise compatible.
Daniel at the banquet on the left and Daniel watching the vision on the right both have short greying hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and a lean, lined face.
Daniel in the vision on the left has thick dark hair and a darker beard. Daniel climbing out of the pit on the right has grey, receding hair and a grey beard and looks older.
Daniel rising from the pit on the left and Daniel in the vision on the right both have short greying hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and a lean, older face.
Daniel in the den on the left has close-cropped black hair, a dark beard and dark brown skin. Daniel rising from the pit on the right has grey hair, a grey beard and lighter tan skin.
Daniel in the vision on the left has a grey-flecked beard, dark-grey hair and medium tan-brown skin. Daniel in the den on the right has a black beard, cropped black hair and darker brown skin.
